indicator("QP RES-2100 · Weekly Open + EMA Ribbon", overlay = true, max_lines_count = 500, max_labels_count = 500, max_boxes_count = 500, max_bars_back = 500)

// ---------- STARTER ----------
st2_on  = input.bool(true,     "Show weekly open",  group = "Starter · Weekly open")
st2_col = input.color(#c9a84c, "Weekly open colour", group = "Starter · Weekly open")
st2_wid = input.int(1, "Weekly open width", minval = 1, maxval = 4, group = "Starter · Weekly open")

st2_o = request.security(syminfo.tickerid, "W", open, lookahead = barmerge.lookahead_on)

plot(st2_on ? st2_o : na, "Weekly open", color = st2_col, style = plot.style_stepline, linewidth = st2_wid)

// ---------- MAIN ----------
mn1_on  = input.bool(true, "Show EMA ribbon",              group = "Main · EMA ribbon")
mn1_l1  = input.int(8,   "EMA 1", minval = 1, inline = "mn1a", group = "Main · EMA ribbon")
mn1_l2  = input.int(26,  "EMA 2", minval = 1, inline = "mn1a", group = "Main · EMA ribbon")
mn1_l3  = input.int(80,  "EMA 3", minval = 1, inline = "mn1b", group = "Main · EMA ribbon")
mn1_l4  = input.int(233, "EMA 4", minval = 1, inline = "mn1b", group = "Main · EMA ribbon")
mn1_c1  = input.color(#ffffff, "", inline = "mn1c", group = "Main · EMA ribbon")
mn1_c2  = input.color(#fff9c4, "", inline = "mn1c", group = "Main · EMA ribbon")
mn1_c3  = input.color(#ffeb3b, "", inline = "mn1c", group = "Main · EMA ribbon")
mn1_c4  = input.color(#ff9800, "", inline = "mn1c", group = "Main · EMA ribbon")

mn1_e1 = ta.ema(close, mn1_l1)
mn1_e2 = ta.ema(close, mn1_l2)
mn1_e3 = ta.ema(close, mn1_l3)
mn1_e4 = ta.ema(close, mn1_l4)

plot(mn1_on ? mn1_e1 : na, "EMA 1", color = mn1_c1, linewidth = 1)
plot(mn1_on ? mn1_e2 : na, "EMA 2", color = mn1_c2, linewidth = 1)
plot(mn1_on ? mn1_e3 : na, "EMA 3", color = mn1_c3, linewidth = 1)
plot(mn1_on ? mn1_e4 : na, "EMA 4", color = mn1_c4, linewidth = 2)
